correctness.rationale: The chronological forcing set attains the upper bound. k distinct path eigenvalues each have m-1 independent spider-arm eigenvectors. When 2(ell+1)>=3k, their polynomial factors as B^z times positive-shift linears and B^2-c^2I (c<=1), all entrywise nonnegative. At least one unmatched negative root gives a positive-diagonal linear factor; intervals of allowed 1- and 2-step lengths cover every distance 1..k. Idle quadratic factors can be placed at a nonleaf endpoint (two leaves cannot be at distance <=k). Thus exact matrix support yields M>=(m-1)k and the standard M<=Z establishes equality; no finite extrapolation.
